title: Fast Art Format (.fart), version 1
description: JSON-backed vector art for games: shapes, recolorable palette tokens, re-posable parts, states. This schema checks structure; spec/FORMAT.md holds meaning, and the validator in packages/core adds the cross-reference checks a schema cannot express (names resolve, tris index the points). Unknown fields are allowed everywhere: editors preserve them, loaders ignore them.

version.description: The format major. Readers must reject anything newer than they know.

palette_refs.description: Other .fart files whose palettes this one borrows, relative to this file, resolved in order. Later refs beat earlier ones; the local palette beats them all.

parts.description: Layers with a pivot. File order is paint order when no state says otherwise.

collision.description: Shapes a game may treat as solid. Never drawn, so color is optional. Rest-space, state-independent.

vec2.description: [x, y]; y-down, x-right, in the project's world units.

rgba.description: [r, g, b, a], each 0-255. The field is called rgb and holds four numbers; that ship has sailed.

relpath.description: A relative path with forward slashes. Never absolute, never a drive letter.

meta.description: Yours. The format never looks inside.

color.description: A palette token, never a literal color.

w.description: Stroke width. Round caps. In a collision list, the capsule's girth.

tris.description: Index triples into points, baked by editors on save. The validator checks the count is a multiple of three and every index is in range.

drawn_shape.description: A shape inside a part: it is painted, so it names a token.

anchor.description: A named document-space point a runtime may ask for: a grip, a muzzle, a hinge.

pivot.description: Document-space point the runtime rotates about and places. Absent means [0, 0].

offset.description: Where the part's pivot lands. Absent means the pivot itself: the rest placement. Note this is a position, not a delta.

rotate.description: Radians about the pivot. Absent means 0.

scale.description: Multiplier about the pivot. Absent or 0 means 1.

state.description: A named part list. Its order is paint order; parts it leaves out are not drawn.
